title: CBS News Spotlights Gridware's Mission to Protect Communities from Wildfires
summary: Highlighted in a recent CBS News article, our technology helps identify potential risks before they escalate, empowering utility companies to enhance safety and protect communities. As wildfires become an urgent concern, Gridware is committed to redefining wildfire prevention and promoting a sustainable future. Join us in our mission to create a safer tomorrow for everyone.
body_markdown:
At Gridware, we're on a mission to safeguard our communities from the devastating impact of wildfires. As highlighted in a recent CBS News article, our innovative technology monitors power grid systems in real time, helping to identify potential risks before they escalate into disaster.


With wildfires becoming an increasingly urgent issue, our team is dedicated to transforming how utilities manage their infrastructure. By providing actionable insights, we empower utility companies to make informed decisions that enhance safety and prevent fires from igniting. Our approach not only protects lives and property but also promotes a sustainable future for the regions we serve.


Read the article and watch the news segment here:[https://www.cbsnews.com/sanfrancisco/news/east-bay-tech-startup-gridware-uses-ai-monitor-grid-prevent-wildfires/](https://www.cbsnews.com/sanfrancisco/news/east-bay-tech-startup-gridware-uses-ai-monitor-grid-prevent-wildfires/)
